verse.verse_1: When the heaven is split asunder,
verse.verse_2: And listens to and obeys its Lord -- and it must do so.
verse.verse_3: And when the earth is stretched forth,
verse.verse_4: And has cast out all that was in it and became empty.
verse.verse_5: And listens to and obeys its Lord -- and it must do so.
verse.verse_6: O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions, a sure returning, and you will meet.
verse.verse_7: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,
verse.verse_8: He surely will receive an easy reckoning,
verse.verse_9: And will return to his family Masrur (in joy)!
verse.verse_10: But whosoever is given his Record behind his back,
verse.verse_12: And he shall enter a blazing Fire, and made to taste its burning.
verse.verse_13: Verily, he was among his people in joy!
verse.verse_14: Verily, he thought that he would never return!
verse.verse_15: Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!
verse.verse_16: But no! I swear by Ash-Shafaq;
verse.verse_17: And the night and what it Wasaqa,
verse.verse_18: And the moon when it Ittasaq.
verse.verse_19: You shall certainly travel from stage
verse.verse_20: What is the matter with them, that they believe not
verse.verse_21: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they fall not prostrate.
verse.verse_23: And Allah knows best what they gather,
verse.verse_24: So, announce to them a painful torment.
